correctness.rationale: The simple locus is invertible matrices with strongly connected support; an edge-cut union bound controls its probability. All automorphisms are monomial on the invertible locus. The no-loops obstruction controls diagonal stabilizers, while ordered-pair permutation orbits control moved-coordinate fixed-space dimension. Burnside then gives the stated limit for each fixed q>=3; finite bounds require x,z<1. The finite checker examples are not an asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Finite cases do not prove unrestricted claim; the symbolic/mathematical argument is assessed separately.
